title: 第7章 一个好办法第8章 神决
content_zh:
自己拥有一个元至尊的分身，一个去宇宙海探索，一个回祖地，这样不就两全其美了么？
自己本体是源境，而分身目前是元至尊，如果让分身去探索宇宙海，实力肯定不够用。
所以林云打算让分身回祖地，本体前往宇宙海。
想到这里，林云当即心意一动，将沉睡在储物戒指中的分身释放出来。
想当初灭道盟之时，林云凭借着本尊与分身的完美配合，以雷霆万钧之势，一举灭了整个道盟，那场面至今回想，起来仍令人心潮澎湃。
而自从自己成就天道之位后，已然无敌，分身也就渐渐派不上用场，之后林云便一直让分身，在储物戒指中沉睡。
如今，自己既然决意到宇宙海中闯荡一番，去探寻一些谜题，那么留下分身守护祖地，无疑是最为稳妥的安排。
分身立于林云面前，从沉睡中苏醒，缓缓睁开双眼，双眼眸中，闪烁着与林云本尊如出一辙的坚毅与果敢。
“对了，还得将天道之心，也让分身带回去才行。”
林云心中暗自思忖。
这一次前往宇宙海探索，前途未卜，万一遭遇什么惊天大难，甚至不幸殒命，那天道之心就极有可能，落入他人之手。
要知道，拿到天道之心，便能成为一个星系的星主。
倘若让别有用心之人得到它，那祖地的未来将会变得难以预料。
而且一旦有新的星主诞生，自己这个老星主的所有亲友，必将面临残酷清洗！
所以，必须确保天道之心的安全，决不能将其带在身上！
虽说一旦本体死亡，分身也会遭受反噬，可能会导致重伤，甚至有一定可能死亡。
但无论如何，分身带着天道之心留在祖地，肯定是最稳妥的。
打定主意后，林云心意一动，璀璨耀眼、光芒流转的天道之心，便从体内缓缓涌出。
林云挥手将其丢向分身，分身一把将天道之心紧紧握住，随即，天道之心便融入到分身体内。
分身的躯体境界是元至尊，虽然比不上本尊的源境。

但在祖地内，源境之下，分身也基本是无敌的存在。
何况它如今还融入了天道之心！
而且祖地并无其他源境强者。
即便只是留下这具分身，也足以掌控祖地局势。
“好了，回去吧！”
林云面带微笑，看着分身。
分身也露出同样笑容，随即转身，化作一道流光，朝着星系最中间的祖地疾驰而去。
林云目视着分身消失在视线的尽头。
随后林云再度转身，看向那无穷无尽、神秘莫测的宇宙海。
此刻，林云的目光熠熠生辉，心中更是波澜壮阔，浑身的热血都在沸腾，有一种难以言喻的兴奋感，在心底蔓延！
在这广袤无垠的宇宙海中，自己将会有怎样惊心动魄的经历？又将会面临多少前所未有的挑战？
接下来的一切，对林云来说都充满了未知和变数！
content_en:
I have a clone of the Yuan Supreme, one to explore the universe sea, and one to return to the ancestral land. Wouldn't this give me the best of both worlds?
His own body is in the Source Realm, and his clone is currently the Yuan Supreme. If the clone is allowed to explore the cosmic sea, his strength will definitely not be enough.
So Lin Yun planned to let the clone return to his ancestral land and the main body to the cosmic sea.
Thinking of this, Lin Yun immediately made a move and released the clone sleeping in the storage ring.
Thinking back to when he destroyed the Taoist Alliance, Lin Yun relied on the perfect cooperation between his true form and his avatar to destroy the entire Taoist Alliance in one fell swoop. Looking back on that scene, it still makes people's hearts beat.
Since he achieved the position of Heaven, he has become invincible, and his clone has gradually become useless. Since then, Lin Yun has been letting his clone sleep in the storage ring.
Now, since I am determined to venture into the cosmic sea and explore some mysteries, leaving a clone to protect the ancestral land is undoubtedly the safest arrangement.
The clone stood in front of Lin Yun, woke up from his deep sleep, and slowly opened his eyes. His eyes flashed with the same perseverance and courage as Lin Yun's original body.
"By the way, we have to bring the heart of heaven and its clone back."
Lin Yun thought to himself.
This time I went to explore the cosmic sea, and the future was uncertain. If I encountered some terrible disaster, or even died unfortunately, it was very likely that the Heart of Heaven would fall into the hands of others.
You know, if you get the Heart of Heaven, you can become the star master of a galaxy.
If someone with ulterior motives gets it, the future of the ancestral land will become unpredictable.
And once a new Star Lord is born, all the relatives and friends of his old Star Lord will surely face brutal purges!
Therefore, you must ensure the safety of the Heart of Heaven and never carry it with you!
Although once the main body dies, the clone will also suffer backlash, which may cause serious injury and even death.
But no matter what, it is definitely the safest thing for the clone to stay in the ancestral land with the heart of heaven.
After making up his mind, Lin Yun's mind moved, and the dazzling, radiant Heart of Heaven slowly emerged from his body.
Lin Yun waved his hand and threw it towards the clone. The clone held the Heart of Heaven tightly, and then, the Heart of Heaven merged into the clone.
The body state of the clone is Yuan Zhizun, although it is not as good as the source state of the original deity.
But in the ancestral land, under the source realm, the clone is basically invincible.
What's more, it is now integrated into the Heart of Heaven!
Moreover, there are no other Origin Realm powerhouses in the ancestral land.
Even if you just leave this clone, it is enough to control the situation in the ancestral land.
"Okay, let's go back!"
Lin Yun looked at the clone with a smile.
The clone also showed the same smile, then turned around, turned into a stream of light, and rushed towards the ancestral land in the middle of the galaxy.
Lin Yun watched the clone disappear from the end of his sight.
Then Lin Yun turned around again and looked at the endless and mysterious sea of ​​space.
At this moment, Lin Yun's eyes were shining, and his heart was filled with excitement. The blood all over his body was boiling, and there was an indescribable sense of excitement spreading in his heart!
In this vast ocean of space, what kind of thrilling experience will I have? How many unprecedented challenges will it face?
Everything that follows is full of unknowns and variables for Lin Yun!
